notes.title: Ship Miner Demo Released!!!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="Vyqf70VIT88;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]I’ve just released the Demo of Ship Miner!!! This is a great milestone for me and the game.[/p][p][/p][p]The game is far from over but I believe the Demo shows part of the core experience of the game. [/p][p][/p][p]The idea is to keep working on the game and update the Demo frequently in order to improve it and communicate better and better what the game is gonna be in the end.[/p][p][/p][p]Hope you enjoy it![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3113690/Ship_Miner/" style="button"]PLAY IT NOW![/url][/p]

notes.title: Ship Miner Private Playtest
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124417/50d4128b6ff283088329d14a1486b9ed75d55a3e.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi Everyone![/p][p][/p][p]This is Ariel from Pixel Core Games, I am working towards having a public Steam Demo in the next couple of months. In order to achieve that I need to polish and define more stuff and I need help from players in doing so.[/p][p][/p][p]If you want to be part of this playtest, you can join by pressing the button in Ship Miner store page:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3113690/Ship_Miner/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]I will add more and more testers overtime. If you request access and get the chance to be part of this Playtest, please also join Discord (check the more ways to connect for the link) and contact me or fill the Feedback Form linked inside the game. Your opinion means a lot and will help me making the best possible game I can.[/p][p]By the way, if you join the Discord and write to me I could also give you a Playtest key directly to be sure you have access to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading![/p]
